verdict.rationale: Pipedream's triggers and actions are source-available, and outside developers can contribute new components by opening a PR on GitHub (pipedream-docs-1, pipedream-docs-31). The CLI can also deploy a component from local or remote code (pipedream-docs-7, pipedream-docs-22). However, community contributions appear to reach users by being merged into the vendor's own registry rather than through an independent install mechanism. Missing for 10: a documented marketplace or install flow for third-party components outside the vendor's repo, any evidence of third-party publishing or discovery, and independent corroboration of developers installing community-built components.
